findings.claim: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`, leaving abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data unimplemented; it is still registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so Detector.detector_handler / process_detectors raise TypeError (Can't instantiate abstract class) for any metric_alert_fire detector, where base returned a working no-op handler. One such detector aborts the whole process_detectors batch.
findings.evidence: Abstract members at src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:142-170; grouptype.py:27 `detector_handler = MetricAlertDetectorHandler`; models/detector.py:86 calls group_type.detector_handler(self). Standard ABC instantiation semantics. Latent today: no production caller of process_detectors/detector_handler in src/. Reasoned repro (not run): `self.create_detector(type=MetricAlertFire.slug).detector_handler` raises TypeError on head, returns handler on base.
findings.reason: Three correctness/spec seats rate it Important with a concrete source-traced path; ponytail rated Minor only because it is latent. Regression from a working stub to an uninstantiable registered handler. Not made red (benchmark mode stops after merge).

findings.claim: build_mock_occurrence_and_event hard-codes the occurrence id and ignores its `value` argument, and IssueOccurrence.__eq__ compares only id, so every mock occurrence compares equal; the new tests cannot detect wrong group_key, value or priority passed to build_occurrence_and_event_data. Expected occurrences are already built with mismatched args (value 6 vs evaluated 100/8/10, group key 'val1' vs 'group_key') and still pass; assert_has_calls(any_order=True) in test_state_results_multi_group cannot distinguish the two groups.
findings.evidence: src/sentry/issues/issue_occurrence.py:181-184 (__eq__ returns self.id == other.id); fixed id 'eb4b0acffadb4d098d48cb14165ab578' in the helper at test_detector.py:244-275; the only hook call site is processors/detector.py:299-301. Reasoned mutation check (not run): change detector.py:300 args to `None, 0, PriorityLevel.LOW` and the test file stays green.
findings.reason: Source-cited: the equality semantics make the new hook's contract untested. superpowers rated Important; mattpocock and ponytail (the ignored-`value`/hard-coded-6 angle) rated Minor. Kept at Important since the new feature's only behavioural check is vacuous.
